idea.title: A few posts every week beats a burst
idea.angle: Posting ten listings in one day and then going quiet for a month means most buyers miss you for weeks. A few good posts every week keeps you in front of them.
idea.hook: 10 POSTS IN ONE DAY. THEN NOTHING.

slides.heading: 10 POSTS IN ONE DAY. THEN **NOTHING**.
slides.body: Posting in bursts feels productive. It quietly costs you buyers.

slides.heading: YOU POST WHEN YOU HAVE **TIME**
slides.body: A quiet day, so you post ten listings. Then a busy month, and nothing. Sound familiar?

slides.heading: MOST BUYERS **MISS** YOU FOR WEEKS
slides.body: Ten posts in a day crowd each other out. Then you go quiet. Buyers who start looking next week never see you.

slides.heading: A FEW GOOD POSTS, **EVERY** WEEK
slides.body: Steady beats busy. A few good posts each week keep you in front of buyers. And it's less work per day.

slides.heading: PICK YOUR POSTING **DAYS**
slides.body: Choose a few days a week you can really keep. Like Monday, Wednesday and Friday. Then stick to them.

slides.heading: SPREAD YOUR **LISTINGS** OUT
slides.body: Have ten listings ready? Don't post them all at once. Share them across the weeks, one or two at a time.

slides.heading: **REPOST** YOUR STRONG LISTINGS
slides.body: Most of your followers missed it the first time. Post your best listings again, in all five places.

slides.heading: POST **STEADY**, NOT IN BURSTS
slides.body: Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook

caption:
Ten listings in one day, then nothing for a month. Most buyers miss you for weeks.

Posting in bursts feels productive, but the posts crowd each other out.
A few good posts every week keeps you in front of buyers.
Pick your days, spread your listings out, and repost the strong ones.
It's less work per day, too.

How often do you post listings right now?

Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook.
